title: C4 farm book segment (book/v1)
description: One sealed segment of a farm's book: the farm-wide, hash-linked log of farm-level acts. The HUD and the people's issuer write the entries, and the leader-elected queue checks each against the record it cites and seals them, signing the segment as component/queue. A segment names the segment before it, so changing any past segment changes every one after it. An entry counts from the first segment that seals it: its position is the book's time.

subject.description: The book's last entry as this segment leaves it: book:<farm>@<position>, with the entry's C4 ID as its c4 digest; or, before the book holds any entry, the farm: farm:<farm>, with the farm's ID.

farm.description: The farm's ID: the C4 ID of the farm CA's certificate, as an act's.

number.description: The segment's number, from 1, one more than the segment it names.

prev.description: The C4 ID of the segment before, as signed. The first segment has none.

first.description: The position of the first entry it seals: one more than the last the segment before sealed.

last.description: The position of the last entry it seals; one less than first when it seals none and only refuses.

entries.description: The C4 ID of each entry it seals, first to last. Each entry names the entry before it (prev) and its position.

refused.description: Entries written for the seal that it refused: they never count.

flags.description: Entries it sealed whose record says it was signed outside the window their position allows. They count, and are flagged.

signedAt.description: When the queue sealed it: the time every position it seals is judged at.

refusal.description: An entry written for the seal that the queue refused, by its C4 ID and a reason from a fixed set: nothing the writer wrote is copied in, so no input can make a segment that doesn't hold together. The queue's log has the detail.

submission.description: The C4 ID of the entry as it was written for the seal.

reason.description: missing: not in the store; malformed: not the canonical JSON of an entry of its kind (a key in another case, written twice or unknown); not-pending: written with a position; other-farm; unknown-kind; unsigned: its writer's signature missing or wrong; booked: booked already; record-missing, unverified, wrong-signer: the record it cites; disagrees: it says something its record doesn't; not-in-force: its signer's device or touch key isn't in force; over-limit: past the entries a seal takes; rejected: any other check.

flag.description: A sealed entry the queue flagged: it counts, and is flagged.

reason.description: window: its record says it was signed outside the window around when the queue first saw it pending; no-time: its record says nothing of when it was signed; unchecked: an adopted entry today's checks refuse, which counts for nothing.

signedAt.description: When the record says it was signed: its signer's claim.

from.description: The earliest the window allows: when the queue first saw the entry pending, less the time a record may wait to be booked.

to.description: The latest the window allows: when the queue first saw the entry pending, plus the clocks' skew.

adopted.description: The first segment of a farm whose people's issuer kept its own index before the book: it seals that index's entries unchanged, as the book's first, under their own prev links.

head.description: The index's last entry, as its head named it.
